title: Week-One Founder Sprint
one_liner: A done-with-you service that turns a free AI-generated business idea into a validated test within seven days.
speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
context: After Bill Gross's free bank of AI business ideas launches, Chamath says ideas are worth little and execution is everything. Salim says lost young people can use the list as a starting point.
customer: Career changers, recent grads and corporate employees with a side project who have picked an idea but never launched
problem: Ideas are now free and plentiful, but most people stall before the first customer conversation, landing page or paid test.
revenue_model: Fixed-price sprint, about $300–$900 per founder (estimate), plus an optional monthly accountability tier around $99 (estimate)
why_now: Free idea databases are flooding people with options, and the hosts say startup costs have fallen from millions to a few thousand dollars, so execution help is now the scarce part.
first_steps: Run one free sprint for a friend and document the before/after
Post the case study in startup and career-change communities with a 5-seat paid beta
Build a reusable kit: interview script, landing page template, $50 ad test
cost_to_start: About 1 week and under $200 (estimate) for a landing page and templates
competition: Startup coaches, accelerators and validation courses are plentiful; a fixed-week, productised sprint is less common
risks: Low willingness to pay among undecided people. Outcomes depend on the founder's effort. Easy for others to copy.

tool.title: Idea Triage Board
tool.one_liner: Score your shortlist of business ideas and get a concrete seven-day test plan for the winner.
tool.demo: The user pastes 3–10 ideas and rates each on interest, access to customers, starting cost and speed to first dollar. The page ranks them and generates a day-by-day validation plan for the top idea, including interview questions and a landing-page headline. With a pasted AI key it drafts the copy; example mode uses templates.
tool.data_plan: User input; optional AI through a visitor-pasted key; template example mode without a key
